newsitem.title: USA: Transworld terminates deal with VIP Cos.
newsitem.headline: Transworld terminates deal with VIP Cos.

text.p: Transworld HealthCare Inc said Wednesday it had terminated agreements to acquire VIP Cos due to delays in completing the due to delays in completing the transaction.
Transworld made the announcement jointly with VIP.

Transworld said it expects to take a pre-tax non-cash charge of approximately $1.6 million during the third quarter of fiscal 1997 relating to the termination of the transaction and other acquisition-related expenses.
VIP, a privately held provider of temporary nursing and related home health services in the New York metropolitan area, operates Kwik Care Ltd and VIP Health Services Inc.
Transworld provides alternate site healthcare services and products, operates a specialized mail order pharmacy and supplies medical supplies to patients nationwide.
